title: NEXY round 13B — canonical logout contract repair
actions: Read exact typecheck/integration/full-suite failure diagnostics from workflow 35611588560.
Proved auth.ts had a duplicate local LogoutBodySchema with optional idempotency_key that contradicted canonical validation schema.
Removed the duplicate local logout schema and imported packages/validation/api.schema.ts canonical LogoutBodySchema.
Kept canonical response {revoked:true}, AUTH_LOGOUT/AUTH_LOGOUT_ALL auditing, RBAC, CSRF and idempotent replay semantics.
Validated repaired candidate through full CI.
root_cause: Duplicate local logout request schema made idempotency_key optional at runtime and typed it string|undefined, causing both handler behavior drift and TypeScript failures.
